text: A high cook, heavy pressing and long dry storage at low humidity make an extra-hard, crumbly cheese with few or no holes. After at least 18 months the paste has crunchy crystals and a fruity, roasted taste.

steps.note: The curd is pressed under up to 1200 kg into wheels of 50–62 cm and 35–48 kg.
The cheese is left for at least 15 days at 10–15 °C in brine of at least 20 °Bé, a strength in Baumé degrees.
